paper.title_en: Every 3D Conformal Field Theory Has an \(\mathcal{L}_{\Lambda}w_{1 + \infty}\) Symmetry
paper.abstract_en: A one-parameter family of deformed \(\mathcal{L}w_{1 + \infty}\) soft symmetry algebras acting on tree-level gravitational theories in \({AdS}_{4}\) has recently been discovered; it is denoted \(\mathcal{L}_{\Lambda}w_{1 + \infty}\). Here, we show that all \({{CFT}_{3}\,}s\), including those dual to quantum gravity on \({AdS}_{4}\), admit an \(\mathcal{L}_{\Lambda}w_{1 + \infty}\) action generated by the ANEC operator, its conformal descendants, and their commutators. This extends previous tree-level results on these soft symmetries to the strongly coupled quantum regime.
